The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day by the Forecast for the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station once information is finalized, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/ph/manila/RPLL.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve to "Yes" until all data for this date has been finalized.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Any revisions to temperatures recorded after data is finalized for this market's timeframe will not be considered for this market's resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent ensemble forecasts from PAGASA and global models show a tight cluster of possible maximum temperatures for Manila on May 26, with the highest values most likely occurring under strong daytime heating before afternoon convection develops. The transition to southwesterly flow is introducing moisture that favors scattered thunderstorms, which could cap peaks near 36–37 °C while allowing clearer intervals to reach slightly higher. Historical May climatology places typical Manila highs around 34 °C, yet current guidance indicates modest positive anomalies from reduced cloud cover early in the day. Updated model runs and PAGASA’s daily outlooks over the next 48 hours will refine whether localized heating or increased rainfall pushes the recorded maximum toward the upper or lower end of the current market range.
